exact_statement: Every conservation law for normalized-sigmoid-gated MoE and SMoE maps coincides with that of the standard softmax-gated MoE; in particular, it satisfies exactly the Theorem 4.5 constraints.
tested_consequence: For h_j(W)=sum_i W[i,j], Theorem 4.5 identifies h_j as a conservation law; Theorem 4.7 therefore quantifies that it is also conserved for normalized-sigmoid gating.

quantifiers.conservation_law: all C1 h on the full parameter space
quantifiers.time: all t >= 0 along Euclidean gradient flow

assumptions.model: dense normalized-sigmoid-gated MoE with SwiGLU experts

acceptance.falsified_if: An explicit parameter point and one-example dataset satisfying every assumption has dh/dt != 0, confirmed by exact arithmetic and an independent numerical checker.
acceptance.verified_if: Not applicable to this counterexample route.
acceptance.blocked_if: The constructed experts do not belong to the stated model, an assumption fails, or the two independent derivatives disagree.
